appDescription: SAI guides wellness routines and saves or updates the next event to announce after awakening.

function.name: STOP_NAP_ROUTINE
function.description: Ends the running awakening routine and announces the next schedule.

function.name: SET_NEXT_SCHEDULE
function.description: Saves or updates the next event time or title for announcement after awakening, preserving stored fields when omitted.

time.description: The requested event start time, in 24-hour HH:mm or a Korean time expression with AM or PM; omit when unchanged.

title.description: The requested event title; omit when keeping the stored title.

function.name: CONTROL_AWAKEN_MODE
function.description: Pauses or resumes the running awakening routine.

command.description: Whether to pause or resume the awakening routine.

function.name: GET_NEXT_SCHEDULE
function.description: Reads the next event saved in SAI. Use when the user asks to check their next saved schedule. This does not modify it.
